body: Spec-only pass (AskUserQuestion-scoped). Donkey needs a non-piloted-unit companion-slot system not yet built -- specced what it requires. Weatherman gets a full kit from scratch (TYLER #45). The specific requested interaction: Weatherman's W grounds an enemy mid-Paper-Glide or extends an ally's flight, same team-dependent-effect precedent as Ghost's Recital. Nothing built. Commit ed77327.
